10k.note: 10-K describes commercialized cloud-connected medical devices (CPAP, bilevel, ventilators, masks) and SaaS for out-of-hospital care. No drug pipeline disclosed.

website.error: no public pipeline page found (resmed.com returns HTTP 403 to fetcher; ResMed is a commercial medtech company without a drug pipeline page)

ctgov.note: All ResMed-sponsored interventional studies are completed device studies (CPAP, Astral VAPS, AutoVPAP, Salt Lake mask). One PHASE3 RECRUITING study (NCT07332442) is Yale-sponsored eszopiclone with ResMed Foundation as collaborator only — not a ResMed proprietary asset.

commercial_product.summary: ResMed designs, manufactures and distributes cloud-connectable medical devices and software for sleep apnea, COPD, neuromuscular disease and other respiratory conditions, plus SaaS for out-of-hospital care providers.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: ResMed is a commercial medical device and digital-health SaaS company (sleep apnea, respiratory care, out-of-hospital software). It does not develop drugs and has no active proprietary P1/P2/P3 clinical pipeline. Historical ResMed-sponsored device studies on ctgov are all completed; remaining trials are investigator-initiated with ResMed Foundation as collaborator only.
